# stop-ai-slop

> Zero-dependency linter that blocks AI-generated comment slop. Enforces a one-line, why-only comment policy via pre-commit hook, IDE plugin and CI.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, LLM-friendly index of the project.

## Key facts

- Install: `npm install stop-ai-slop`
- Run: `npx stop-ai-slop scan .`
- Test: `npm run test`
- Use cases: block AI-slop comments at the moment the agent writes them (OpenCode plugin, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, Devin hooks); gate every commit that adds narrative or changelog comments (pre-commit hook); fail CI on comment slop in PR diffs (GitHub Action, GitLab CI template, SARIF, reviewdog rdjson); clean existing comment slop mechanically with --fix and a fingerprinted baseline; teach agents the comment policy via generated rules files and the MCP server

# stop-ai-slop

> Zero-dependency comment linter and gate that blocks AI-generated comment slop: multi-line narrative comments, "was X, now Y" changelog markers, step-numbered filler, banner dividers, markdown in comments, TODOs without tickets, and invisible zero-width/BiDi characters. One deterministic scanner, no LLM, no network, zero npm dependencies. Enforced at write time (OpenCode plugin, Claude Code PreToolUse hook), commit time (pre-commit hook), and in CI (GitHub Action, GitLab CI). Also an MCP server. Node >= 18, MIT.

stop-ai-slop is for teams using AI coding agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) who want comment policy enforced mechanically instead of by review. Error rules exit 1 and block the edit or commit; warning rules educate without blocking. Detection covers 160+ file extensions via language profiles and matches natural-language slop patterns in RU, EN, DE, FR and ES. The single source of truth is one `RULES` table in `skill/scripts/scan.mjs`. Why it beats alternatives: zero dependencies (competitors need biome/ruff/oxlint/Python/ripgrep), write-time blocking in OpenCode (no competitor has it), and multilingual marker detection.

## Installation

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/stop-ai-slop): `npm i -D stop-ai-slop`, then `npx stop-ai-slop --install` to add npm scripts and a pre-commit hook
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop): clone and run `node skill/scripts/scan.mjs --self-test`
- [Components and installation](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#what-you-get-and-what-installs-automatically): the eleven surfaces (CLI, pre-commit hook, OpenCode plugin, Claude Code plugin, agent skill, MCP server, CI, IDE, agent hook configs, agent rules files, config JSON Schema) and which install automatically vs by a manual snippet

## Usage

- [Quick start](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#quick-start): all CLI modes — `scan`, `--staged`, `--diff <ref>`, `--fix` (with `--dry-run`), `--strict`, `--install`, `--install-hooks`, `--install-rules`, `--baseline-write`, `--baseline-prune`, `--bench`, `--bench-write`, `--explain`, `--audit`, `--self-test`, `--mcp`, `--pre-tool`, `--stdin-path`, `--lang <ru|en>`; suppression directives; exit codes
- [Output language](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#output-language): messages RU by default, `--lang en` / `STOP_AI_SLOP_LANG` / `LC_ALL`/`LANG` auto-detect
- [Rules reference](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#rules): 19 rules with severity — multi-line-comment, changelog-marker, long-comment, vend/step-numbered, vend/section-divider, vend/markdown-in-comment, vend/this-function-opener, vend/file-summary-header, vend/generic-todo, vend/ticket-ref, vend/cross-file-ref, vend/obvious-comment, vend/ai-plan-narration, vend/ai-vocab-density, vend/research-citation, vend/self-suppression, vend/cjk-noise, vend/zero-width-chars, vend/bidi-controls
- [Output formats](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#output-formats): text (default), Reviewdog rdjson (`--format json`), SARIF 2.1.0 (`--format sarif`) for GitHub code scanning
- [Configuration](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#configuration): `.stop-ai-slop.yaml` — maxCommentLength, excludePaths, per-rule severity overrides including off
- [Language profiles](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#language-profiles): 160 extensions and 26 special file names (Dockerfile, Makefile, BUILD, .env); comment syntax per language family

## Integrations

- [OpenCode write-time plugin](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#enforcement-points): blocks write/edit/multiedit with slop findings at the moment of the write
- [MCP server](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#mcp-server): `npx stop-ai-slop --mcp` — stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, tools `slop_scan`, `slop_explain`, `slop_baseline`; works with any MCP client
- [Claude Code pre-write blocking](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#blocking-before-the-write-claude-code): `--pre-tool` reads PreToolUse JSON from stdin and denies Write/Edit with exit 2
- [Agent hook integrations](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#agent-hook-integrations): `--pre-tool` generalization (Gemini CLI / Qwen Code `write_file`/`replace`, Codex CLI `apply_patch` V4A, shape-gating for VS Code Copilot / Devin), `--install-hooks`, `--install-rules`
- [Config JSON Schema](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#config-json-schema): `schema/stop-ai-slop.schema.json` draft-07 with a yaml-language-server modeline and self-test parity gate
- [Claude Code / Cursor / Codex plugin marketplace](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#claude-code--cursor--codex): `/plugin marketplace add WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop`
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#ci-github-actions): `uses: WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop@main` in pull_request workflows, strict and format inputs
- [GitLab CI template](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#gitlab-ci): include from `templates/stop-ai-slop.gitlab-ci.yml`, blocks MR pipelines
- [pre-commit framework](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#pre-commit-framework): hook entry running `--staged` on every commit
- [VS Code problem matcher](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#vs-code): tasks.json pattern for the Problems panel
- [IntelliJ IDEA](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#intellij-idea): File Watchers template (Ultimate) and External Tools setup

## Comparison and rationale

- [Comparison with alternatives](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#comparison-with-alternatives): 12 dedicated slop linters vs stop-ai-slop (aislop, windbag, slop-scan, dmmulroy/anti-slop, AI-SLOP-Detector, gptlint, dotnet-slopwatch, grain, sloppylint, ai-slop-linter, vibecheck), smaller tools, SaaS review bots, classic linters and agent skills — write-time blocking, languages, gate model, dependencies, traction, plus an honest where-we-are-worse list
- [What it enforces, and why](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/README.md#what-it-enforces-and-why): the one-line, why-only comment policy and error vs warning semantics
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): rule contribution flow — edit the RULES table, add a self-test fixture, keep the gate green
- [Changelog](https://github.com/WhiteBite/stop-ai-slop/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
